reasons: Regime: credit-led — Credit is involved — more serious than an equity-only dip.
Hedge pricing (not in composite): Put skew / cost of tail insurance cheap, Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV) cheap

indicators.label: HY credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Level 2.71% (amber ≥4.5%), 5d change -4bp (amber ≥+30bp). A fast widening is the best short-lead credit signal.

indicators.label: CCC credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Junkiest credit tier — closest public proxy for the leveraged AI periphery.

indicators.label: HYG/IEF ratio (credit vs safety)
indicators.detail: High-yield ETF vs Treasuries — a same-day credit read with no FRED lag.

indicators.label: Leveraged loans (BKLN)
indicators.detail: Floating-rate senior secured loans — isolates credit risk from rate moves. Tracking HY closely (+0.0pp 10d).

indicators.label: SOFR − IORB (funding stress)
indicators.detail: Repo rate over the interest-on-reserves floor; a persistent positive spread means funding stress.

indicators.label: Funding tail (SOFR spread + Fed repo use)
indicators.detail: SOFR 99th−1st percentile 13bp (amber ≥30bp); Fed repo ops $0.1bn (3d max) (amber ≥$5bn). Needs both legs to confirm stress over calendar effects.

indicators.label: Chicago Fed NFCI
indicators.detail: Weekly financial-conditions composite; positive = tighter than average.

indicators.label: VIX term structure (VIX/VIX3M)
indicators.detail: ≥1.00 = backwardation — the near-coincident confirmation signal (days of lead at most).

indicators.label: Put skew / cost of tail insurance
indicators.detail: SKEW 134 (expensive ≥145), VVIX 89 (expensive ≥110). Tail insurance is comparatively cheap. Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV)
indicators.detail: VIX 14.6 sits at the 5th percentile of its trailing year (expensive ≥80th); 20d realized 14.0, so implied carries +0.7 vol points of premium (expensive ≥8). Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Periphery canaries (CRWV, ORCL)
indicators.detail: Sharp equity drops or realized-vol spikes in the debt-financed periphery stand in for CDS.

indicators.label: Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
indicators.detail: Narrowing breadth = fragility backdrop; slow signal, low weight.

indicators.label: Yield curve (10y−3m)
indicators.detail: Inversion is a 6–18 month gauge, not a timing signal — capped at amber.

items.headline: Banks hit concentration limits on AI data-center loans, push risk to pension and private-credit funds
items.note: Oracle's $38B data-center construction debt is proving too large for JPMorgan and SMBC to hold, forcing banks to offload exposure into pension and insurance portfolios — a sign the traditional syndication channel is straining.

items.headline: CMBS investors push back on AI data-center debt as 'Luddite trade' spreads
items.note: KKR-backed CyrusOne and Blackstone-backed QTS both had to widen pricing on recent commercial mortgage bond sales to clear demand, a concrete sign of spread widening in data-center CMBS.

items.headline: AI loan investors demand covenants after CoreWeave spread blows out 125bps
items.note: Lenders forced CoreWeave to accept maintenance covenants and pay up 100-125bps more on a $2.6B facility, a realized tightening of terms on GPU-backed debt.

items.headline: CoreWeave CDS pricing implies ~50% five-year default odds as stock drops 9%
items.note: Credit-default-swap spreads on CoreWeave widened to 855bps, materially repricing the market's view of GPU-backed neocloud debt ahead of its Q2 print.

items.headline: Moody's flags Oracle and CoreWeave as the weakest credit links in AI's hyperscaler buildout
items.note: Moody's research note cites Oracle's Baa2-negative rating and CoreWeave's Ba3 rating, and warns $1.2T in off-balance-sheet lease commitments across six hyperscalers understate true leverage.

items.headline: S&P downgrades Oracle to BBB-, one notch above junk, on OpenAI concentration risk
items.note: A realized ratings action tying Oracle's AI capex buildout and its heavy OpenAI revenue concentration directly to a credit downgrade, leaving the company one step above speculative grade.
